narration: E1.2 第一版原型（临时草稿）。设计：命名四个函数 doubleAddOne(n)=2n+1、half(n)=n/2、sq(n)=n²、shift(n)=n+1 与四个具体集合 S/T/negOne/posOne；像与原像用 rintro ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ + rcases 枚举 + norm_num 逐元素求值，原像用 omega/nlinarith 解方程；反例用具体见证 + 否定。一次编译。
goal: 整文件编译：doubleAddOne '' {0,1,2} = {1,3,5}；doubleAddOne ⁻¹' {1,3,5} = {0,1,2}；sq '' {0,1,2} = {0,1,4}；sq ⁻¹' {1} = {-1,1}；sq '' ({-1} ∩ {1}) ≠ sq '' {-1} ∩ sq '' {1}；¬ Surjective doubleAddOne；¬ Injective half；Bijective shift
plan: 先证四条定义展开（rfl）与基本性质，再逐元素算像／原像（norm_num/omega/nlinarith），最后用具体见证证三个反例与一个双射正例（经理论条目 bijective_iff_inverse 给逆映射 n-1）。
attempt_code:
theorem preimage_doubleAddOne : doubleAddOne ⁻¹' ({1, 3, 5} : Set ℕ) = S := by
  ext x
  simp only [Set.mem_preimage, S, Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff, doubleAddOne]
  omega
theorem preimage_sq_one : sq ⁻¹' ({1} : Set ℤ) = ({-1, 1} : Set ℤ) := by
  ext x
  simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_singleton_iff, Set.mem_insert_iff, sq]
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hfac : (x - 1) * (x + 1) = 0 := by nlinarith
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hfac with h1 | h1
    · right; linarith
    · left; linarith
  · rintro (rfl | rfl) <;> norm_num
theorem sq_image_inter_ne : sq '' (negOne ∩ posOne) ≠ sq '' negOne ∩ sq '' posOne := by
  intro h
  have hmem : (1 : ℤ) ∈ sq '' negOne ∩ sq '' posOne :=
    ⟨⟨-1, by simp [negOne], by norm_num [sq]⟩, ⟨1, by simp [posOne], by norm_num [sq]⟩⟩
  rw [← h] at hmem
  rcases hmem with ⟨x, hx, _⟩
  simp only [negOne, posOne, Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx
  omega
